validation.nativeCountEvidence: one baseline catalog walk, then zero walks across repeated reads and live-status flips, one walk when an unknown live child appears
validation.nativeOutcomeEvidence: error (LlmFailure verbatim), interrupted, max-tokens, blocked, refusal and foreign aborted each open one deduped item and one wake; own cancellations and completed runs do not; an absent or unreadable turn/end is reported as unobservable with an evidence pointer

review.independentReview: Owner-reported: several subagents were running while the instrument showed zero. Root cause was a count derived from our own dispatch reservations, which misses natively started children and reloads, plus a catalog field whose 'running' means resident rather than executing. The count is now the host's live run status over a membership set refreshed only at membership-change nodes, so reads cost no catalog walk. The 'silent stop' inference was replaced by the host's published terminal vocabulary: error with the LlmFailure facts, interrupted for a turn that never ended normally, max-tokens, blocked, refusal and aborted with its cancel cause, deduplicated per session:run:turn through a durable row and never guessed when the child log cannot be read. A time-based cache was proposed and rejected by the owner: subagent activity changes at dispatch and return, so it is maintained from those events instead. Bounding the window operations journal was implemented, measured as a net loss (whole-document writes, lossless compaction duplicating each operation) and reverted; the measured options are documented.
